title: Oven Baked Tunisian Fish Bake
description: A light and crisp Tunisian dish featuring fish, coco sugar, and a blend of spices, perfect for a pescatarian-friendly meal. This dish is cultured and flavorful, with a unique blend of ingredients.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a small bowl, mix together coco sugar, olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, cumin, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Place the cod fish fillets in a baking dish and brush the sugar and spice mixture evenly over both sides of the fish.
Bake the fish in the preheated oven for 12 minutes or until cooked through.
Remove the fish from the oven and let it rest for 2 minutes before serving.
Serve the fish hot, garnished with fresh parsley or cilantro if desired.
This dish can be served with a side of quinoa or couscous for a complete meal.
Leftovers can be stored in the refrigerator for up to 2 days.
